RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: unknown; the information does not support a defensible number

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications are strong, but a leadership role may prioritize management, regulatory expertise, or strategic judgment; an announcement won’t capture the successful candidate’s full qualifications.

After two weeks, follow up on your request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your candidacy was assessed, and feedback explaining the decision.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related comments, inconsistent criteria, or preferential treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for an explanation may not extend them.
